channel.title: Mathematical Institute, University of Wrocław — news
channel.description: Announcements, events and achievements of the Mathematical Institute, University of Wrocław.

item.title: Popular science lecture in the MISIU series
item.description: Mathematics and Computer Science Meetings at the University (MISIU) is a series of lectures popularising mathematics and computer science for secondary school students.

item.title: Prof. Andrzej Hulanicki Award for Agnieszka and Mariusz
item.description: Two equal-ranking Andrzej Hulanicki Awards for 2025 were presented to Dr Agnieszka Hejna-Łyżwa and Dr Mariusz Tobolski.

item.title: University Medals for Professors Marek Bożejko and Tomasz Rolski

item.description: Analysis and simulations of the non-linear models with non-local dispersal of species considered in finite, flat habitats

item.title: The tutoring room opens
item.description: From 19 October, senior students help with maths problems in room 202 — especially first-year students.

item.title: Welcome, first-year students
item.description: The matriculation ceremony of the Faculty of Mathematics and Computer Science took place on 29 September in the Leopoldina Hall.

item.title: 2nd Congress of Young Explorers
item.description: Nearly 170 students from almost 20 secondary schools took part in lectures, workshops and an outdoor game.

item.description: On sequences of measures and ideals in Boolean algebras

item.description: A preparatory course for students admitted to the first year at the Faculty — from 25 September.

item.title: Lecture by Prof. Uwe Franz
item.description: Open lecture “Who was Seki Takakazu?” as part of the IDUB programme.

item.title: We have been awarded the A+ research category
item.description: Mathematics at the University of Wrocław received the highest research rating, A+.

item.title: Baby Steps Beyond the Horizon — a school for students
item.description: A school in Będlewo (30 August – 5 September 2026) showing students the breadth of current mathematics. On-site registration until 31 July.

item.title: Statistics seminar
item.description: Two meetings on statistical methods for high-dimensional data and modelling in molecular biology — 22 and 24 June.

item.title: Andrzej Hulanicki Award
item.description: Dr Piotr Dyszewski and Dr hab. Michał Marcinkowski are the winners of the first edition of the award.

item.title: Faculty seminar — Prof. Olga Vitek
item.description: Statistical methods increase the accuracy and the interpretability of quantitative proteomic investigations

item.title: Course evaluation surveys
item.description: Surveys evaluating summer-semester classes can be completed in USOSweb until 30 June.

item.title: Lvzhou Chen wins the Kamil Duszenko Prize
item.description: The winner of the twelfth edition works at Purdue University in geometric group theory.

item.title: Sierpiński Medal for Prof. Tadeusz Januszkiewicz
item.description: One of the most important and prestigious mathematical distinctions in Poland.

item.title: Mariusz Mirek and Błażej Wróbel receive the 2026 Frontiers of Science Award
item.description: The award recognises a paper co-authored with Jean Bourgain and Elias M. Stein.

item.title: Kazimierz Kuratowski Prize for Maciej Kucharski
item.description: The prize recognises a series of papers in harmonic analysis.

item.title: Changes to the library regulations
item.description: From 27 April, University of Wrocław libraries charge fees for overdue books. Loan limits and periods also change.

item.title: Thesis competition
item.description: Results of the Faculty of Mathematics and Computer Science competition for the best diploma thesis.

item.title: Motiejus Valiunas's success in the NCN competition
item.description: Dr Motiejus Valiunas's project was the top-rated project qualified for funding in the SONATA BIS 15 competition.

item.title: Copernicus Prize for Mariusz Mirek
item.description: Prof. Mariusz Mirek has received the Nicolaus Copernicus Scientific Prize awarded by the Polish Academy of Arts and Sciences.

item.title: Hugo Steinhaus Scholarship for Piotr Błaszkiewicz
item.description: PhD student Piotr Błaszkiewicz has received the Hugo Steinhaus Scholarship awarded by the Wrocław Academic Centre.
